## Week 1: the identity books

- [Book 02 — Identity & Directory](../../books/b02-identity/index.md) (Book, 15 chapters, about 8 hr 33 min). Active Directory to Entra ID: why identity matters, what changes, who owns it, and how to do it.
- [Book 04 — Access & Privilege](../../books/b04-access/index.md) (Book, 14 chapters, about 7 hr 52 min). Conditional Access, privileged roles, applications and access governance: why every access decision is a policy decision, and how to run it.

*Milestone 1: about 16 hr 25 min.*

## Week 2: privileged access

- [Privileged Access in Microsoft Entra ID and Azure](../../training/privileged-access/index.md) (Learning path, 8 modules, 9 hr 14 min). Eight modules, one per chapter of the Privileged Access developer workbook, each with a lab on fixtures and a lab in your own test tenant.
- [Labs: Building Privileged Access](../../training/labs.md#pa) (Lab, 16 labs). 16 hands-on labs across 8 chapters or modules: Lab 1 runs on the kit's fixtures with no tenant, Lab 2 in a test tenant. Building Privileged Access.

*Milestone 2: about 9 hr 14 min.*

## Week 3: HR-driven identity

- [HR-Driven Identity in Microsoft Entra ID](../../training/hr-driven-identity/index.md) (Learning path, 7 modules, 7 hr 32 min). Seven modules, one per gate of the HR-driven identity implementation guide, each with a lab on fixtures and a lab in your own test tenant.
- [Labs: Building HR-Driven Identity](../../training/labs.md#hr) (Lab, 14 labs). 14 hands-on labs across 7 chapters or modules: Lab 1 runs on the kit's fixtures with no tenant, Lab 2 in a test tenant. Building HR-Driven Identity.

*Milestone 3: about 7 hr 32 min.*

## Week 4: non-person identity

- [Non-Person Identity in Microsoft Entra ID](../../training/non-person-identity/index.md) (Learning path, 13 modules, 15 hr 6 min). Thirteen modules: one per chapter of the developer workbook, in the order of the implementation guide's six gates, then the deployment runbook, then one service account migrated by hand, then the managed service account standard, each….
- [Service Accounts: From User Accounts to gMSAs to Microsoft Entra Workload Identities](../../books/guides/service-account-migration.md) (Implementation guide, about 1 hr 24 min). A comparison and migration guide for every kind of service identity, on premises and in the cloud: a user account used as a service, a standalone MSA, a group managed service account (gMSA), a Windows Server 2025 delegated managed….

*Milestone 4: about 16 hr 30 min.*

**Whole plan:** about 49 hr 41 min of reading and video, plus the labs.
